service_boundary: Represents the current Tencent Cloud TokenHub service, not the deprecated Hunyuan and LLM Knowledge Engine sales paths, Tencent consumer products, TI-ONE, or individual model publishers.
regional_controls: Tencent documents separate Singapore global, Guangzhou mainland-China, and Silicon Valley US API addresses and scheduling scopes.
retention_controls: TokenHub terms authorize Tencent and applicable third-party model providers to process user inputs; effective retention depends on the selected model, operational mode, and applicable provider terms.
routing: Manual mode uses a customer-selected model. Auto Mode for eligible plans selects a model based on the input; third-party models can be reached through Tencent as an intermediary.
customization: The platform documents pay-as-you-go, guaranteed resources, and exclusive deployment; availability is model- and region-specific.
strengths: A current unified Tencent Cloud service spans Hunyuan and several major third-party model families.
Official docs expose regional endpoints and automatic model-selection behavior.
tradeoffs: Third-party models add publisher-specific terms and downstream processing boundaries.
The predecessor APIs are being migrated, so integrations must target the current TokenHub endpoints.
